prompt: Here's the bootstrap and request-handling code for two microservices — Service A (the caller) and Service B (the callee) — both wired up with OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation and exporting spans to Jaeger. Individually each service produces spans just fine, but in Jaeger the request that flows A → B never shows up as one connected parent/child tree: you get two separate traces with two different traceIds, and Service B shows up as an orphan trace on every single request, even though nothing throws and both services are supposedly "fully instrumented." Walk me through the code, find exactly where the trace breaks at the A → B hop, and tell me how you'd fix it so both spans end up sharing one traceId.
